column5: Product forms include wire, sheet and tube; these reference numbers are not tied to a lot or assay. Conductivity is labelled room temperature without a numeric temperature; density, Cp, E and nu also lack exact test temperatures. Unknown-temperature and pressure flags are mandatory. Cp 0.133 J/(g K) is 133 J/(kg K). No numeric room-temperature interval is invented. The independently tabulated shear modulus is excluded from an exact E/nu tensor claim.

Annealing schedule, test temperature, rate and specimen geometry are unstated. The strength values are producer references, not design minima. Elongation 40 percent is 0.40. Requires work-hardened=0; no interpolation to partly worked states is admitted.

Amount and route of cold work, test temperature, rate and specimen geometry are unstated. Elongation 3 percent is 0.03. Requires work-hardened=1; the endpoints do not define a hardening curve or interchangeable material conditions.
